WHAT: PostgreSQL server encoding could not be read. EXPECTED: the server reports UTF8. HOW: inspect the cluster encoding and initialize a new cluster with --encoding=UTF8 if necessary, then rerun setup.

WHAT: PostgreSQL max_connections could not be read. EXPECTED: max_connections is at least ${psql.default.max.connections}. HOW: inspect postgresql.conf, set max_connections to at least ${psql.default.max.connections}, restart PostgreSQL, and rerun check.

fail.message: WHAT: PostgreSQL server major version is ${psql.actual.major}, not ${psql.version}. EXPECTED: PostgreSQL major ${psql.version}; PostgreSQL 18 is the current default. HOW: point psql.host/psql.port at the intended server or set psql.version explicitly when another supported major is intentional, then rerun check.

WHAT: authenticated PostgreSQL user ${psql.actual.user} does not have CREATEDB. EXPECTED: CREATEDB=true for the configured test account. HOW: grant CREATEDB to that role using an administrator, or run setup against a local server with bootstrap authentication, then rerun check.

WHAT: PostgreSQL server encoding is ${psql.actual.encoding}, not UTF8. EXPECTED: server_encoding=UTF8. HOW: initialize a new cluster with --encoding=UTF8, or use a cluster with UTF8 encoding, then rerun check.

WHAT: PostgreSQL max_connections is ${psql.actual.max.connections}, below the required minimum of ${psql.default.max.connections}. EXPECTED: max_connections >= ${psql.default.max.connections}. HOW: set max_connections to at least ${psql.default.max.connections} in postgresql.conf, restart PostgreSQL, and rerun check.

WHAT: PostgreSQL cluster initialization needs psql.home. EXPECTED: psql.home points to the PostgreSQL installation root containing bin/initdb and bin/pg_ctl. HOW: run ant -Dpsql.home="C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18" setup or persist psql.home in local infra/postgresql/config.properties.

WHAT: PostgreSQL initdb was not found: ${psql.initdb.executable}. EXPECTED: a complete PostgreSQL installation under psql.home. HOW: install PostgreSQL ${psql.version} or correct psql.home, then rerun setup.

WHAT: PostgreSQL data directory exists but is not an initialized cluster: ${psql.data}. EXPECTED: the directory is absent or contains PG_VERSION. HOW: choose an empty/configured psql.data, or remove this non-cluster directory manually before rerunning setup; existing data is never deleted automatically.
